age-value: {p0:0 years|# year|# years}, {p1:0 days|# day|# days}
itemdesc-groomingbrush: Hold right click on a dirty animal to brush it clean. Cleans twice as well as a wisp of dry grass, and faster. Wears out with use.
itemdesc-chickencoop-*: Right-click the ground to build a small raised coop there, stretching away from you: on four posts, with a pitched roof, a little ramp up to the pop hole, two hen boxes inside and steps up to a gate at the back, where you can walk in to collect the eggs. Room for 6 to 8 hens, and shelter underneath too. Needs a clear spot of 5 by 9 blocks, 6 high.
coop-onground: Right-click the top of the ground to build the coop
coop-noroom: Not enough room for the coop: it needs a clear spot of 5 by 9 blocks, 6 high
coop-noground: The posts and the ramp of the coop need solid ground under them
coop-blocked: Something is standing where a part of the coop would go
blockdesc-waterer-raw: Fire it in a pit kiln to make a waterer.
blockdesc-waterer-fired: A clay bell drinker: a wide, low dish that even chickens can reach. Fill it with a bucket; thirsty animals walk to it and drink.
dustbath-none: no dry sand nearby for a dust bath
water-natural: drinks from fresh water nearby ({0}, offset x {1}, y {2}, z {3})
water-container: drinks from a barrel or bucket ({0} L left)
water-undrinkable: no drinkable water within {0} blocks (hot spring, salt and dirty water are not drinkable)
nursing-unwell: its mother is unwell and has little milk
nursing-orphan: orphan, feed it at a trough
nursing-orphan-handfeed: orphan, does not know the trough yet: feed it by hand
interact-handfeed: Feed by hand (milk or its food)
handfed-left: {p0:# more feeding|# more feeding|# more feedings} and it learns to eat from a trough.
handfed-learned: It has learned to eat from a trough now.
handfeed-suckling: It is suckling from its mother and is not hungry.
